Above: Aussie Mike "Mad Dog" Morgan was hoping to make the Commonwealth Games team for Wales in the Long Jump. Unfortunately he found out that they insist that their athletes must have competed in the Welsh Championships for at least two years.

Highlights of the day were:- the first Club appearance of Mike 'Mad Dog' Morgan who won the long jump in impressive style; Haroun Korjie also in Belgrave colours for the first time and clocking an excellent 10.53; the same time to 1/100th for for Du'aine Ladejo and Phil Goedluck in the 'A' and 'B' 2…
Our own Mike Morgan put the pressure on Freddie as well. He led the competition by popping out his best jump of 7.59m in round one while the other two came up with their best leaps in round 6!
Michael Morgan repeated his long jump victory to put down a marker for the opposition and cleared 2 metres in the high jump to gain valuable points.
John Mackenzie stood in for Mike Morgan in the long jump and Mike repaid the favour in the triple jump, his first and last triple jump competition ending in injury.
